title: Lesson 27: Integration Security: Named Credentials, JWT, Certificates, and IP Allowlisting
description: The security layer under every integration: named credentials that keep endpoints and secrets out of code, JWT bearer for server-to-server auth, certificates for signing and mutual TLS, and IP allowlisting as the last fence that says who is even allowed to knock.
